name: Flexopack Societe Anonyme Commercial and Industrial Plastics Company
summary: Flexopack Société Anonyme Commercial and Industrial Plastics Company, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells flexible plastic packaging materials in Greece, other European countries, and internationally. It primarily offers barrier and non-barrier films. The company's products include shrink bags and films, skin films, thermoforming films, lidding films, and vacuum pouches; lamination films; and multi-layer co-extrusion films. It serves the food industry, which include meat, poultry, cheese, and fish, as well as printing/conversion and personal care packaging industries. The company was founded in 1979 and is based in Koropi, Greece.
